title: Strong Acceleration and Pickup
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the G70 as having strong, responsive acceleration and notable pickup, while some fragments mention performance in descriptive terms without a clearly labeled sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise quick pickup, strong acceleration, and responsive power delivery, with one example also noting efficiency for the vehicle’s size.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments describe acceleration or pickup as strong, adequate, different-feeling, or remarkable, but the sample does not provide enough context to interpret a clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: All examples are from the US G70, so this topic summary does not cover other models or markets.
Several fragments are labeled undetermined despite favorable wording, which limits confidence in interpreting overall sentiment from the text alone.
The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 acceleration feedback.
